XMLDB.COMMENT: Tables for the Mercado Pago Subscriptions enrolment plugin.

TABLE.NAME: enrol_mercadopagosub_sub
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per Mercado Pago preapproval. Rows are never deleted: a subscriber who leaves and returns gets a new row, mirroring the platform, which does not allow deletion either.

FIELD.NAME: enrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: Enrolment instance this subscription pays for.

FIELD.NAME: preapprovalid
FIELD.COMMENT: Mercado Pago preapproval id, 32 hexadecimal characters in practice.

FIELD.NAME: externalreference
FIELD.COMMENT: The only field that travels to Mercado Pago and comes back, so it is the sole correlation key. The platform accepts at least 200 characters.

FIELD.NAME: payeremail
FIELD.COMMENT: The address the subscription was created with. Mercado Pago returns this field as an empty string and never populates it, so this column is the only record of it.

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: Local lifecycle: pending, trialing, active, overdue, ended.

FIELD.NAME: endreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Set when state becomes ended: abandoned, unpaid, cancelled_by_user, cancelled_by_admin, cancelled_by_mp.

FIELD.NAME: mpstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Last known remote status: pending, authorized, paused, cancelled.

FIELD.NAME: frequencytype
FIELD.COMMENT: Only days and months are accepted by the platform.

FIELD.NAME: nextpaymentdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Anchored to the moment of authorisation, not of creation. Drives timeend on the user enrolment.

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Set only for bounded subscriptions.

FIELD.NAME: payerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Assigned by Mercado Pago at creation, derived from payeremail. Immutable.

FIELD.NAME: dunningstage
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 none, 1 first notice sent, 2 second notice sent.

FIELD.NAME: dunningsince
FIELD.COMMENT: When the subscription first went overdue. The notice schedule counts from here.

FIELD.NAME: timesynced
FIELD.COMMENT: Last successful read from the API. The reconciliation task orders by this.

FIELD.NAME: extras
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON for anything that does not warrant a column.

TABLE.NAME: enrol_mercadopagosub_payment
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per authorized payment, read from /authorized_payments/search. Never written from a webhook body.

FIELD.NAME: periodstart
FIELD.COMMENT: Enrolment period this payment opened. Kept for audit: it is what the subscriber paid for.

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: Redacted API response, capped. Never raw card or identification data.

TABLE.NAME: enrol_mercadopagosub_event
TABLE.COMMENT: Raw webhook deliveries. The endpoint writes here and returns 200; a scheduled task does the work.

FIELD.NAME: topic
FIELD.COMMENT: subscription_preapproval, subscription_authorized_payment, subscription_preapproval_plan, payment.

FIELD.NAME: resourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The id the notification points at. May belong to another plugin sharing the application: those are logged, answered 200 and ignored.

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: x-request-id header, part of the signature manifest.

FIELD.NAME: signaturestatus
FIELD.COMMENT: verified, failed or absent. Enforcement fails closed.

FIELD.NAME: processstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: queued, processed, ignored, failed.

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: Body as received, redacted and capped. Treated as a signal, never as a source of truth.
